description.value: Set in a working fruit orchard on Hwy 97 in Oliver, this full-service RV park offers shaded grass sites, secure bike storage at no charge, and flush washrooms a short walk from town. Flat roads, surrounding wineries, and nearby lakes suit a relaxed cycling tour of the Okanagan.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a motel, cabin, and RV park set in a fruit orchard in Oliver. The front page explicitly mentions 'wide level flat roads are perfect for cycle tours,' and both the facilities and rooms pages confirm 'secure bike storage' at no extra charge. Showers, laundry, Wi-Fi, vending, and BBQ facilities are confirmed on the facilities page. OSM had minimal tags (name and tourism=caravan_site only), so address, phone, and most detail come from the website.
concerns: OSM tagged only as caravan_site but business is a combined motel, cabin, and RV park — may also warrant an Accommodation category listing
No dedicated hiker/biker or tent-only sites mentioned — primarily RV sites and built accommodation
Website copyright shows 2035, likely a template default rather than an actual date
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active accommodation with explicit cycle tourism welcome messaging, dedicated secure bike storage, and strong amenities. Well-positioned on Highway 97 in Oliver for South Okanagan touring routes.
enrichment_extras.notes: Pet-friendly rooms available on request; RV guests may bring pets at no extra charge. Complimentary BBQ patio and clubhouse kitchen for all guests.

wow_evidence: secure bike storage at no charge; wide level flat roads are perfect for cycle tours
